pre_push_full: governance scope and immutable audit history
aggregate/named coverage policy without diff unless base is explicitly supplied
template registry, generated drift and health
ci_project_check: full profile with governance base and diff-coverage base
SPDX SBOM and SHA-bound evidence artifacts

differences: pre-commit does not run Bandit, AST, Vulture, format, mypy, coverage or health
pre-push invokes full without --coverage-base, so diff coverage is skipped there; CI supplies a base
pre-commit mutates versions, links and generated status after its first fast check and then reruns fast, but does not run the full profile after mutation
secret history, dependency, workflow/shell, container and SBOM checks are CI-only
